nom: COSRX Red Rice Inositol Pore Clarifying Deep Cleanser

avis.texte: I've been using the COSRX Red Rice Inositol Pore Clarifying Deep Cleanser for a while now, and I'm still undecided on whether it will stay in my routine. Every so often, my skin looks a bit red right after washing, but interestingly, I haven't had a single breakout from it. That alone makes me want to keep testing it.One thing I absolutely love is that I haven't seen any blackheads in weeks - which is surprising because the current weather is usually a guaranteed trigger for me. The clarifying effect is definitely real. Plus, my skin never feels dry or tight afterward, which is a huge bonus for a deep&clean type cleanser.The packaging, however, could use some improvement. The heart-shaped opening is cute, but I'm not convinced it's necessary. I'm more concerned about how sanitary it is and would prefer a smaller, simpler opening. I'm also not sure if my bottle was just faulty, but it doesn't close completely unless I press very hard. I like my products to seal tightly, so this was a bit disappointing.Overall, the cleanser performs well - especially for pore care - but I'm still monitoring how my sensitive skin reacts long-term. With better packaging, this could easily become a staple.

I really like this as a cleanser, but I haven't tried it as a mask yet, I'll do that next. I was so tired last night, I completely forgot to do the first step of my double cleanse and went right in with this cleanser. I was like, oh this is gonna be a mess when I realized what I'll done haha. But it took all my makeup off and left my face really soft. Love this!
